description: Create a Pix deposit charge, returning a copy-and-paste (BR Code) the human OWNER pays to fund this wallet with DePix. amount_cents is BRL cents; payer_tax_number is the PAYER's CPF/CNPJ. Not a checkout QR. Creates a charge but moves no money itself.

amount_cents.description: Amount in BRL CENTS (integer). e.g. 1000 = R$10.00. DePix is pegged 1:1 to BRL. NOT sats.

payer_tax_number.description: CPF/CNPJ of the OWNER who will pay the Pix QR (the payer). It is the human funding the deposit — not necessarily the wallet holder.

name: wallet_create_deposit

id.description: Deposit id — pass it to wallet_wait_deposit.

qr_copy_paste.description: The Pix copy-and-paste (BR Code) the human OWNER pays. Never a checkout QR.

sandbox.description: true when this is a sandbox (sk_test_) deposit — DO NOT pay it.

title: Create Pix deposit
